title: ClimaScapes
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: In the context of climate emergencies, ClimaScapes rethinks the relationship between architecture, nature, and the city. The volume explores streetscapes as spatial and climatic infrastructures integrating ecological processes, everyday life, and urban design. Through reflections, methodological tools, international case studies, and interviews, the book introduces the ClimaScapes Atlas as an interpretative and operational device for transforming public spaces through Nature-Based Solutions and climate-adaptive green and blue infrastructures.
